Asthma

Overview

Asthma is a chronic respiratory condition used as fixture content.

Causes and risk factors

The causes and risk factors section contains sufficient representative fixture text for deterministic disease page classification. It describes environmental triggers, clinical history and factors associated with the condition without representing production medical content.

Signs and symptoms

The symptoms section is intentionally long enough to pass the configured content threshold. It provides stable HTML for unit tests and allows the classifier to combine URL, title, content root and medical section signals.

Diagnosis

Diagnosis fixture text verifies that the page contains multiple medical sections rather than a menu, search result or generic landing page.

Treatment and prognosis

Treatment and prognosis are present only as classification keywords. Automated tests must never treat this fixture as real medical guidance.
